New concept 'bmi_percentile' (BMI percentile for age and sex) was used. The vocabulary concept 'bmi' is raw BMI, and 'obesity' includes overweight (the 85th percentile), so neither matches the ≥95th percentile threshold.

New concept 'intensive_behavioral_weight_intervention' (provision of or referral to a comprehensive, intensive behavioral intervention) was used. EHR data may not reliably show whether an intervention meets 'comprehensive, intensive' criteria such as contact hours; that requires human mapping.
No upper age limit is stated ('children and adolescents'), so none was encoded. A reviewer may want to cap the age at the end of adolescence.
The text gives no lookback window for the BMI measurement and no timeframe for the intervention or referral. Measurement-year windows were assumed and declared as derived.
The Practice Considerations section on behavioral interventions (content, intensity, contact hours) is referenced but not included, and was not represented.
The asterisk on the date ('June 2024 *') refers to a note not included in the section text.
